subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept leader-verified group kill with direct-PID fallback as the new omitted-detached Unix cleanup behavior after this branch is rebased?
rationale: The code fix is plausible and well proven, but it changes shared process-cleanup semantics for existing omitted-option callers and now needs conflict resolution against current main.

options.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup After Rebase
options.body: Resolve the dirty branch, preserve the detached invariant in current cleanup paths, rerun CI, and land if maintainers accept direct-PID fallback for unverifiable omitted callers.

options.title: Require Stricter Caller-State Plumbing
options.body: Ask for more explicit spawn-time detached state at remaining cleanup call sites before changing the shared helper default.

options.title: Replace With Maintainer Branch
options.body: Close or pause this PR only if maintainers prefer a fresh branch to resolve the rebase and compatibility policy together.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup After Rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty branch, preserve the detached invariant in current cleanup paths, rerun CI, and land if maintainers accept direct-PID fallback for unverifiable omitted callers.
